author: Pilsbry & Olsson, 1943

note.en: A small shelled green slug on Caulerpa, known here from two intertidal specimens at Manzanillo; the name is based on the Pacific and may need a check.
note.es: Una pequeña babosa verde con concha sobre Caulerpa, conocida aquí por dos ejemplares intermareales en Manzanillo; el nombre se basa en el Pacífico y conviene verificarlo.

sources.t: GBIF: preserved specimens, Universidad de Costa Rica collection (Calderón, Avila and others, 1998 to 2003)
WoRMS / MolluscaBase: valid name and classification

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 2 museum specimens, intertidal, Manzanillo (2001, 2002).

marks.en: Green sap-sucking slug with white and brown spots, a thin shell and lobes (parapodia) folded over the back.
marks.es: Babosa verde con manchas blancas y pardas, concha delgada y lóbulos (parapodios) plegados sobre el dorso.
